summary: Portal Marketing Improvement Testing - Iteration 7. All 12 requested features verified and working. 3 new improvements tested: (1) Revenue Chart dropdown filter per-akun, (2) AccountCard navigation to AccountDetailPage, (3) AccountDetailPage with KPI cards, Revenue Trend, and tabs.
passed_tests: ✅ TEST 1: chart-account-filter dropdown (data-testid='chart-account-filter') present in Marketing Dashboard showing 'Semua Akun'
✅ TEST 2: Revenue Chart can be filtered to specific account (Tiktok Shop - Test Live) via dropdown
✅ TEST 3: AccountCard (data-testid='account-card-TT-LIVE-01') has cursor-pointer and clicking card body navigates to AccountDetailPage
✅ TEST 4: 'Lihat Detail' button (data-testid='view-dashboard-TT-LIVE-01') on AccountCard opens AccountDetailPage
✅ TEST 5: AccountDetailPage (data-testid='account-detail-page') renders with header: 'Tiktok Shop - Test Live' + AccountBadge (🎵 pink TikTok badge) + 'active' status badge
✅ TEST 6: All 6 KPI cards present: Total Revenue, Total Orders, Avg Order Value, Health Score, KOL/Creator (3 yang di-assign), Live Host (1 yang di-assign)
✅ TEST 7: account-revenue-chart (data-testid='account-revenue-chart') present with account-specific title 'Revenue Trend — Tiktok Shop - Test Live'
✅ TEST 8: Sales History tab (data-testid='tab-sales') shows empty state 'Belum ada data sales untuk akun ini'
✅ TEST 9: KOL Creator tab (data-testid='tab-creators') shows 3 creator cards (Citra Lestari/KOL-003, Budi Santoso/KOL-002, Ayu Dewi/KOL-001) with Sesi/Revenue/Viewers stats
✅ TEST 10: LiveHost tab (data-testid='tab-hosts') shows 1 host card (Test LiveHost - part_time · Rp 50.000/jam)
✅ TEST 11: 'Kembali' button (data-testid='back-to-dashboard') returns to Marketing Dashboard (AccountDetailPage removed from view)
✅ TEST 12: 'Input Sales' button (data-testid='goto-input-sales') navigates away from AccountDetailPage to Sales module
critical_code_review_comments: AccountDetailPage.jsx implementation is clean and comprehensive. All data-testid attributes are present for testability.
MarketingDashboard.jsx: detailAccount state switching pattern (null=dashboard, object=detail) is clean and works correctly. No issues.
AccountCard.jsx: Both card body click (onClick=handleViewDashboard) and 'Lihat Detail' button both navigate correctly.

MINOR: AccountDetailPage fetches all livehosts and filters client-side (not server-side) for assigned accounts. This is noted in the code comment ('client-side filter'). For large datasets, server-side filtering would be more efficient, but acceptable for current scale.
AccountDetailPage is 412 lines - within acceptable range.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data: TT-LIVE-01 account, 3 KOL creators (KOL-001/002/003) assigned to TikTok, 1 LiveHost (Test LiveHost) assigned to TikTok. No new seed data created.

test_credentials.platform: Tiktok Shop - Test Live (TT-LIVE-01) account used for testing

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 Portal Marketing improvements are working: (1) Revenue Chart per-account dropdown filter, (2) AccountCard click→AccountDetailPage navigation, (3) AccountDetailPage with 6 KPI cards, Revenue Trend, and 3 tabs (Sales History empty, KOL Creator 3 cards, LiveHost 1 card). The 'Set Akun Aktif' bonus button is also present and functional. No bugs found in this iteration.
